visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a vast, snow-covered mountain slope under a heavy, foggy sky. Two figures in winter ski attire are walking away from the camera through deep snow toward a traditional red Japanese torii gate that stands as a stark contrast against the white and gray landscape. (2) The perspective shifts to a unique white geodesic dome structure situated in the snow. A pair of skis and poles are propped up beside the entrance, and several orange markers delineate a path in the powdery surroundings. (3) A man appears in a close-up selfie shot, wearing a dark blue ski helmet, iridescent green goggles reflecting the snowy environment, and a black neck gaiter. He speaks enthusiastically while his breath fogs slightly in the cold air. (4) A first-person POV shot shows a hand in a black winter glove scooping up a handful of fine, dry powder snow and letting it blow away, demonstrating its light texture. (5) Inside the dome, the setting transitions to a warm-lit interior featuring a wooden table with a cardboard box for drawing fortunes (Omikuji). Traditional paper lanterns with Japanese characters flank the table. (6) The man in the ski suit holds a narrow paper fortune slip, unfolding it to read the contents while gesturing to the camera with expressive hand movements.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy male narration in Mandarin. His voice is bright and animated, set against a backdrop of a light acoustic guitar strumming at a moderate tempo. Faint outdoor wind noise and the rhythmic crunch of footsteps in snow are audible. (2) A sharp 'bubble' sound effect triggers a transition. The music becomes more rhythmic as the speaker expresses surprise at the weather conditions. The vocal pitch is dynamic, often peaking with excitement. (3) As the scene moves inside, the acoustic environment shifts to a drier room tone. The sound of paper rustling becomes prominent as the speaker unfolds a fortune slip. (4) The speaker reads the fortune with a playful, theatrical tone, occasionally pausing for emphasis. Background laughter from a female voice is heard momentarily during a humorous remark. (5) The track ends with a series of high-pitched vocal outbursts from the main speaker and a final upbeat musical flourish.
